_comment: QC stress profiles + tool catalog (docs/stress-harness.md). A profile is an ordered list of stages; each stage names a tool from 'tools' and its parameters. The harness stamps QPC-timestamped markers around every stage (for the external 1kHz power-rig correlation), samples telemetry when available, scans WHEA over the window, and writes a device-ID'd JSONL report. Tools are located under stress-tools/ on the stick; a tool whose binary is absent is reported as unavailable and its stages are skipped (never fabricated). NOTHING here runs during provisioning - the stress harness is a separate QC step (tools/Invoke-StressTest.ps1).

tools.title: Prime95 (CPU/FPU torture)
tools.note: Pull from mersenne.org per-machine; not redistributed in-repo. Small-FFT torture for heat/power, blend for RAM+cache.

tools.title: diskspd (storage)
tools.note: Microsoft diskspd; read/write mix, non-destructive to a scratch file on the target drive.

tools.title: CEC GPU thrasher (CubeCL)
tools.note: Our custom Rust/CubeCL burner (docs/stress-harness.md): load-shape scenarios (steady/burst/sweep/cross-load) + closed-loop wattage targeting; emits its own QPC markers. Binary shipped in the payload once built.

profiles.name: smoke
profiles.description: Fast sanity pass - short CPU + storage + VRAM, catches gross instability before a full soak.

profiles.name: soak
profiles.description: Full QC soak - CPU blend, VRAM, storage, then GPU steady + bursty + CPU-cross-load worst case.

profiles.name: power
profiles.description: Power-draw characterization for the 1kHz rig - GPU wattage targeting sweeps + CPU max power, dense markers.
